  "additionalFields": baseTypeModel.metadata.mfgx.labelField,
  "type": 'combobox',
  "dataPath": field.name,
  "target": {
    "dataPath": "filter." &

        $exists(joinTablePrefix) ? joinTablePrefix & "."

      (isRelation ? '._some' : '._in')

  "multiselect": true,

}
